# We'll go to previous song repeatedly until we reach a liked song.
# Liked song IDs: 33, 299, 117, 68, 82
liked_ids = {33, 299, 117, 68, 82}

# First, check current song
current = apis.spotify.show_current_song(access_token=access_token)
print("Current song:", current)

# Loop until we find a liked song
max_steps = 20  # safety limit
for i in range(max_steps):
    if current['song_id'] in liked_ids:
        print(f"Found liked song: {current['title']} (id={current['song_id']})")
        break
    # Go to previous song
    apis.spotify.previous_song(access_token=access_token)
    current = apis.spotify.show_current_song(access_token=access_token)
    print(f"Step {i+1}: now at song_id={current['song_id']} title={current['title']}")
else:
    print("Did not find liked song within limit")
